title: Why Netflix Mailed DVDs for 10 Years #shorts
description: The compounding advantage explained with Netflix's DVD-to-streaming story.

scenes.narration: Why did Netflix keep mailing DVDs for ten years?
Because the best companies build a slow advantage first, and only then make the big leap.
Every DVD they shipped taught them what people actually watch, and when they stop watching.
By two thousand seven, Netflix had over seven million subscribers and a recommendation engine nobody could copy.
So when streaming arrived, they were ready. Subscribers grew from about seven million to over two hundred million.
The leap looked sudden. The advantage took ten years. So, why did Netflix keep mailing DVDs?

visual.text: The leap looked sudden. The advantage took ten years.
